top.title: Dubai Metro station to home in a driverless pod? RTA studies new transport routes

top.impact_reason: Improves community accessibility and transport links.
top.headline: RTA studies driverless pods connecting metro to residential communities
top.summary: Dubai is exploring autonomous electric pods to link metro stations with neighborhoods and business districts. This initiative forms part of the Dubai Glydways project to improve commuter transit.

top.title: Dubai introduces digital Nol QR tickets for metro, buses and trams
top.teaser: Public transport passengers in Dubai can now use digital QR codes on their phones to access the metro, trams and buses, eliminating the need for a single-use red paper Nol ticket. Passengers can buy digital Nol QR tickets through the Nol Pay or S'hail apps, the Roads and Transport Authority announced. top.impact_reason: Enhances daily commuting convenience across the city.
top.headline: Dubai launches digital QR tickets for public transport
top.summary: Commuters can now use mobile QR codes via specific apps for metro, bus, and tram travel. This digital rollout replaces traditional paper tickets to streamline public transit.
top.why: Enhanced public transport convenience positively impacts urban mobility and community desirability.
